listing.name: Controllable Domain Mothership
listing.summary: Adds in a custom ship that mimics the Domain Mothership. Ship is not automated, and needs crew and human captain/officer. Currently it is only available via console command and/or blueprint.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a custom ship that mimics the Domain Mothership, requiring crew and a human captain.

description:
Adds in a custom ship that mimics the Domain Mothership.
Ship is not automated, and needs crew and human captain/officer.
Currently it is only available via console command and/or blueprint.
DOWNLOAD
(No dependencies needed, I think.)

Spoiler

Positives-
Incredible amount of hull integrity, and great armor.
Targeting Supercomputer built in. (Increases ballistic and energy weapons range by 250%, however Point Defense only gets a 60% bonus)
8 Fighter bays

Negatives-
Only 4 medium weapons for it's size (2 energy, 2 ballistic), and 12 small energy weapon slots.
Abysmal Turn speed
Top speed of 28
Massive
No shields

Overall,
S-Tier tanking, potential PD capability, and fighter bay amount,
F-Tier *** for everything else.

I got most of the numbers from adding the mothership and all of the attachments together and accounting for the guidelines, so let me know if bits are too OP or anything.

Spoiler
hullid= contdomainmothership

First mod, feedback greatly appreciated. Again, let me know about anything.

aiDescription: Adds a custom ship that mimics the Domain Mothership. The ship is not automated and requires crew and a human captain or officer. It is currently only available via console command or blueprint. The ship features high hull integrity, armor, a built-in targeting supercomputer, and eight fighter bays, but suffers from low turn speed, no shields, and limited weapon slots.
